collections.name: users
collections.purpose: Stores user account information and detailed multi-step profile data (headline, bio, roles, experience with photos, education with photos, projects with photos, social links with ordering).

fields.id: string - Firebase Auth UID or COOK user ID
fields.name: string - Full name
fields.avatar: string - Profile photo URL (uploaded from PC or Google account)
fields.headline: string - Professional headline
fields.socialLinkItems: array of objects with platform, url, order, visibility
fields.experience: array of experience items with companyLogo and photos gallery
fields.education: array of education items with institutionLogo and photos gallery
fields.projects: array of project items with imageUrl and gallery
fields.onboardingCompleted: boolean - true when profile creation steps are finished

collections.access: Public read; write restricted to authenticated owner (request.auth.uid == userId)

collections.name: posts
collections.purpose: Home feed posts, startup pitches, and community ideas

fields.author: object with id, name, username, avatar, role

collections.access: Public read; create/update/delete restricted to post author

security_rules_summary: Users can only write to their own profile document. Posts can only be created, modified, or deleted by their verified author. Public read is enabled for feed exploration.
